pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark brown regions with soft-to-moderately sharp pixel gradients at the edges. Patch size is largest on the upper neck and shoulder, progressively decreasing in area toward the lower limbs while maintaining a roughly tessellated arrangement.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes primarily feature three-way intersections. Corridor thickness is non-uniform, appearing wider at the base of the neck and narrower on the lateral flank and lower limbs.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour along the upper neck mane. The hair presents as a dense, uniform brush-like silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical skin fold visible at the anatomical junction of the lower neck and the cranial shoulder region.
